reasoning: South Carolina is strongly Republican-leaning on the statewide Cook PVI, at about R+18. In the last 45 days, the only relevant statewide election polling I found was for the South Carolina U.S. Senate special Republican primary, which is not the general-election Senate race; I found no qualifying current general-election Senate or presidential matchup poll for South Carolina. As a result, the current race margin is not available from a qualifying statewide general-election poll, and the best structural baseline is the state’s R+18 PVI.

sources.name: Cook Political Report

sources.details: A Resonance Media Strategies poll for the South Carolina Republican Senate special primary found Darline Graham Nordone leading the field with 25.2%, while Ralph Norman had 18.2%; this was a primary poll, not a general-election matchup.
